use.flag: Build the SYCL backend (libggml-sycl.so) for Intel Arc discrete GPUs, using dev-lang/intel-oneapi-dpcpp and sci-libs/mkl built with sycl. Required for sci-ml/llama-cpp built with sycl to actually gain a SYCL backend: llama-cpp links against the system ggml, so its own USE flag cannot produce the backend library on its own.

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Overlay copy of sci-ml/ggml carrying an additional sycl USE flag. The ::gentoo package offers no SYCL backend, which leaves Intel Arc GPUs reachable only through Vulkan; this copy exists solely to close that capability gap and should be retired if ::gentoo ever gains the flag.
